pages.title: Not Just Sand
pages.text: The Brush supports later archaeology and elixirs help with dangerous ruins.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Explore traps, routes and puzzles while keeping an exit. Any native fatigue-clear guardian rule belongs to that temple; this goal does not invent a new pack boss.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Explore traps, routes and puzzles while keeping an exit. Any native fatigue-clear guardian rule belongs to that temple; this goal does not invent a new pack boss.

pages.title: Verified native mechanic
pages.text: Find the Pharaoh deeper in the temple: this version uses a specially equipped Husk with the native head, not an invented custom entity type. Its death inside the tagged temple marks that temple as cleared and removes temple mining fatigue from affected players inside temple structures. An ordinary

pages.title: Verified native mechanic
pages.text: Husk does not do this. Explore passages and traps; entering a pyramid does not mean it is cleared.
